patch_description:
1. Reduce the amplitude resolution and bounds of the surrogate grid-search to quickly produce a robust topological initialization (preventing local minima on the wrong side of the school). 
2. Introduce a full Adam Optimization loop natively applied to the `Y` values.
3. Analytically differentiate `F1`, `F2`, and `F3` w.r.t the coordinates, resulting in perfectly continuous smooth optimization (the F1 gradient mathematically behaves like a Laplacian, naturally smoothing out the line against any F2/F3 field distortion).
